context_for_next_testing_agent: Signature visibility bug fix verified. DocumentViewer fetches signatures from /meetings/{meeting_id}/documents endpoint and renders positioned ones (pos_x/pos_y > 0) as absolute overlays. SignaturePlacement also fetches existing signatures and shows them while placing new ones. Download-signed PDF uses ReportLab Canvas to draw signatures at their mapped positions (frontend 800x1000px to PDF A4). Key data-testids: document-viewer, doc-sig-count, sig-overlay-{sig_id}, signature-placement-overlay, existing-sig-{index}, draggable-signature.
